title: 游
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L213. Latest origin/main may already contain some dependency lessons; this request recomputes missing dependencies from origin/main and keeps only missing dependency characters as provisional. Production owns the asset-complete lesson-local package; Release owns production JSON, planner, ledger, registry cleanup, final verify, merge, and deploy.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: origin/main production JSON through L210 plus provisional learned chars 船/魚 plus current target from newChars
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 image style anchors only as illustration style references, not character identity references.
Do not copy any L058 adult woman, child, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Name any human role identity clearly in image prompts: fantasy mermaid role, passerby swimmer, and other non-protagonist roles.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, ship names, map labels, direction-arrow text, subtitles, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice or cut production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 海水裡有小魚游來游去，畫面重點是小魚在海裡游動的方向和姿態。不可有文字、數字、水族箱標籤或水印。
水鳥站在河邊或低飛在河面上，看得見河裡的魚。畫面要清楚有水鳥、河水和水中的魚。不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 晚上，人魚在海面上看船。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 晚上人魚在海面上看船
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 晚上的幻想海面場景，一位人魚公主風格的人魚角色在海面上看著遠方的船。這是童話幻想角色，不是真實人物；display text 不可寫「公主」，因為「公、主」未學。不可有文字、數字、船名、標籤或字幕。
一艘大船停在較窄的河口或河道前，無法開進河的上游；畫面要清楚表現大船太大、河道往上游變窄。不可有文字、數字、方向箭頭、地圖標籤、船名或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 一大早，有人在海裡游水。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 一大早有人在海裡游水
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 一大早，路人游泳者在海裡游水，畫面要安全，有岸邊或成人安全情境，水不要太深太危險。人物身份是路人游泳者，不是主角家庭成員；不可只畫模糊人物。不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

G01.reason: 「游來游去」是本課核心動作用法，目標字清楚。

G05.correctText: 晚上，人魚在海面上看船。
G05.wrongOneText: 晚上，小魚在海面上看船。
G05.wrongTwoText: 晚上，人魚在河面上看船。
